data.name: Penuel
data.long_meaning: In the Bible, Penuel is a place name that means 'Face of God'. This name was given to Jacob when he wrestled with a man (possibly an angel) all night, and when the man touched him at the hip, Jacob exclaimed, 'I have seen a god face to face, yet my life has been saved.' This encounter left Jacob with a permanent limp as a reminder of the event.
data.spiritual_meaning: Penuel can be seen as a symbol of encountering and experiencing God's presence in our lives, even in difficult times.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with a life path number 3 are creative and artistic, and they often have a strong communication skill. They are also empathetic and caring.

in_hebrew.name: פנואל
in_hebrew.meaning: פני אלוהים, פגשתי אלוהים בפני אל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פנואל הוא שם שמשמעותו 'פני אלוהים' או 'פגשתי אלוהים בפני אל'. השם פנואל מורכב משתי מילים: 'פנים' שמשמעותה פנים או מול, ו'אל' שמשמעותו אלוהים. השם נגזר מהשורש פנא, שמשמעותו פגש או פנה. השם פנואל מוזכר בתנ"ך, בספר בראשית, פרק ל"ב, פסוק ל', כשם המקום בו יעקב התעמת עם המלאך וקרא למקום 'פנואל' כי 'נפגשתי עם אלוהים פנים אל פנים'.

in_greek.name: Πηνουήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Πηνουήλ σημαίνει 'Προσωπον Θεου' ή 'εναντιον Θεου'. Το όνομα προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και συγκεκριμένα από τις λέξεις 'פנים' που σημαίνει πρόσωπο και 'אל' που σημαίνει Θεός. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη δεν υπάρχει άμεση αναφορά στο όνομα Πηνουήλ, αλλά η σημασία του συνδέεται με την έννοια της συνάντησης με το Θεό, όπως και στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη.

in_latin.name: Penuel
in_latin.long_meaning: Penuel nomen hebraicum est quod significat 'Facies Dei' vel 'Deus meus'. Nomen derivatum est ex verbis hebraicis 'פנים' quod est facies et 'אל' quod est Deus. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Penuel non invenitur directe, sed significatio eius habet connexionem cum idea occursus cum Deo.

in_english.name: Penuel
in_english.meaning: Face of God, Meeting with God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Penuel originates from the Hebrew language, meaning 'Face of God' or 'Meeting with God'. It is derived from two Hebrew words: 'panim,' meaning face, and 'El,' meaning God. Penuel is mentioned in the Bible, in Genesis 32:30, as the name of the place where Jacob wrestled with an angel and exclaimed, 'I have seen God face to face.' The name Penuel symbolizes a direct encounter with the divine, reflecting a profound spiritual experience. Throughout Christian tradition, Penuel has been used as a given name, signifying a personal and intimate relationship with God.

biblical_reference.note: The name Penuel is given to the place where Jacob encounters the angel.

data.cultural_impact: The name Penuel carries significant cultural impact as it is derived from the Bible, a foundational text of Christianity. Penuel is a reminder of the transformative power of religious experiences, as Jacob's encounter with the divine left him changed forever.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Penuel holds profound spiritual significance as it represents the encounter between God and an individual. It reminds us of the importance of seeking out divine experiences and the impact they can have on our lives. The name Penuel encourages us to continually strive towards deepening our spiritual connection with God.

historical_references.reference: Genesis 32:30, Jacob names the place Peniel (Penuel) because he saw God face to face, and his name was changed to Israel.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Penuel continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Penuel from Dublin, Ireland embodies the meaning of Penuel - "Face of God". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Penuel means "face of God" in Hebrew. It symbolizes the moment of encounter and recognition of God's presence in one's life. The name carries the spiritual significance of acknowledging God's grace and revelation.
